evidence.reason: build() now passes the selected render's sha256, source_sha and template_blob_oid to ProductionUnitAdapter as expected_render, and preflight refuses before any mutation when a fresh render differs from it, closing the gap where a render changed between select() and preflight() would still be installed and started (local tests not run; the harness permits only git commands, so CI is the authority).
